description: Fork-project assertions written in Phase 22 that Phase 22 never runs under the real fork project (npm run test:fork starts Hardhat; Phase 22 runs no Hardhat command, AC-08). Each is a dated obligation for 22-29 to register; whichever phase first runs npm run test:fork must check these assertions by name under the real fork project.

entries.assertion: fork project rails (SPEC R4) > module scope: the Telegram token and every test/.env.test key except the fork shell keys equal their sentinels (AC-13)
entries.why_unrun: npm run test:fork starts Hardhat through the fork globalSetup (test/fork/setup.ts), and Phase 22 runs no Hardhat command (AC-08)
entries.proven_meanwhile_by: test/unit/rails/childRails.test.ts setup-fork child cases (railsEntry 'setup-fork': sentinel env, fork mode, Telegram deny on, DB denied; fork shell keys (i)-(v))
entries.rehearsed_by: test/rails/vitest.fork-rehearsal.config.ts (project fork-rehearsal: the fork project's setupFiles, fileParallelism, pool and timeouts pinned by test/unit/rails/forkRehearsalParity.test.ts, without the Hardhat globalSetup)
entries.owner_reason: ROADMAP Phase 25 success criterion 3 (the fork suite passes with the updated harness and artifact paths) is the first v7.0 criterion that runs the fork suite; whichever phase first runs npm run test:fork must check this assertion by name under the real fork project

entries.assertion: fork project rails (SPEC R4) > in-worker fork shell key: ETH_FORK_RPC_URL is present, non-empty, not the sentinel, and preserved (AC-17)
entries.why_unrun: npm run test:fork starts Hardhat through the fork globalSetup (test/fork/setup.ts), and Phase 22 runs no Hardhat command (AC-08)
entries.proven_meanwhile_by: test/unit/rails/childRails.test.ts 'fork shell keys (SPEC R4 / AC-17)' cases (i)-(vii) in railsEntry 'setup-fork' children
entries.rehearsed_by: test/rails/vitest.fork-rehearsal.config.ts run wrapped with ETH_FORK_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/rehearsal-marker (a dead loopback marker; nothing connected to it); ledger fork-shell-key ETH_FORK_RPC_URL preserved, ALLOW_REAL_MAINNET absent
entries.owner_reason: ROADMAP Phase 25 success criterion 3 (the fork suite passes with the updated harness and artifact paths) is the first v7.0 criterion that runs the fork suite; whichever phase first runs npm run test:fork must check this assertion by name under the real fork project, with the operator's real fork URL in the shell
